name: Pixieset
description: Pixieset is an all-in-one photography platform for client galleries, proofing, digital delivery, print and download sales, websites, studio management, bookings, contracts, invoices, and payments. Photographers use its connected products to deliver images, run their online presence, and manage client work.
agentUseSummary: Pixieset is not available as a direct Relay connection because the provider does not publish a supported developer API, third-party OAuth application program, hosted MCP, or complete operation contract. Relay will not infer private application endpoints, automate the signed-in product, or repurpose credentials and consent flows that Pixieset documents for PayPal, Instagram, Zoom, and other named integrations.

providerSetup.blocker: Pixieset's current official product, help center, and apps page document customer-facing products, an official Lightroom plugin, a mobile app, and named third-party integrations, but no public API reference, developer console, third-party OAuth application program, hosted MCP, endpoint schemas, permission model, quotas, credential lifecycle, webhook contract, or independent distribution terms.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Pixieset unavailable. Re-evaluate only if Pixieset publishes a supported public API, third-party OAuth application program, hosted remote MCP, or documented direct integration contract with exact operations, permissions, quotas, credential lifecycle, and redistribution terms.

evidence.supports: Pixieset's current official product surface comprises Client Gallery, Website, Studio Manager, Store, and Photo Editor, without a public developer API or integration program.
Pixieset's official apps page offers its Lightroom plugin, Studio Manager mobile app, and Photo Editor but no public SDK, API reference, developer console, or hosted MCP.
Pixieset documents a specific Studio Manager-to-Zoom authorization flow, which grants Pixieset access to Zoom rather than exposing Pixieset accounts to third-party applications.
Pixieset's API-credential guidance concerns users supplying PayPal NVP/SOAP credentials to Pixieset for checkout; those credentials do not authorize access to Pixieset data.
